title: Pole Test Protocol for Mice Orientation
author: Ana Catarina Carapinha Cascalho

steps.title: Habituate Mice
steps.instruction: Habituate the mice for 00:30:00 prior to testing by placing their cage in the testing room.

steps.title: Position Mouse on Pole
steps.instruction: Place the mouse with its head oriented upward on top of the pole (50cm tall/0.8cm diameter), with the base of the pole inside the cage.

steps.title: Record Descent Times
steps.instruction: Record the time required for the animal to orient itself facing downward (time to T turn) and the total time to descend to the base of the pole (total time).

substeps.instruction: A trial can be repeated a maximum of 5 times.
Analyze Time to descend (from placing to cage) and Time to transverse (middle section marked on the pole, 30cm, located 14 cm from the top and 8cm from the bottom ends).

steps.title: Manage Animal Behavior During Test
steps.instruction: Apply the following rules based on animal behavior during the descent:

substeps.instruction: If the animal does not turn and begins to descend, gently tap it to motivate movement.
If the animal descends with a lateral body position instead of turning, attribute Ttotal to Tturn (e.g., Ttotal=13s and Tturn=13s).
If the animal falls off the pole immediately, assign maximum scores for Tturn (120 sec) and Ttotal (120 sec).

steps.title: Determine Trial Validity
steps.instruction: Repeat the trial if any of the following conditions are met:

substeps.instruction: The animal pauses for >5s while descending.
The animal turns down and then turns back up.
The animal does not turn and walks up a distance greater than the distance between 2 marks.

steps.title: Clean Equipment
steps.instruction: Clean the pole by disinfection with umonium between different mice.
